description: This file declares interface functions for the ComM module related to ECU mode indications, specifically 'RunModeIndication' and 'WakeUpIndication', for a vehicle communication stack in an AUTOSAR environment.

methods.name: ComM_EcuM_RunModeIndication
methods.description: Indicates a change to a specific run mode for the given network channel.

methods.name: ComM_EcuM_WakeUpIndication
methods.description: Indicates a wake-up event on the specified network channel.
